ModMetaData.name: 学徒契约 Apprentice Bond
ModMetaData.author: ColonySeries
ModMetaData.description:
学徒契约 / Apprentice Bond (RimWorld 1.6)
玩家手动指定 1 导师 + 1 学徒 + 1 技能。同房间工作时学徒获得导师本次 XP 的 15%～25%，导师得 5% 教学加成；学徒每日契约 XP 有硬帽。绑定心情、拆约、导师死亡创伤、出师。无多对多师徒网、无跨地图传 XP。
Manual 1 mentor + 1 apprentice on one skill. Same-room XP share 15–25% (apprentice) / 5% teach (mentor), daily hard cap, bond moods, graduation, mentor-death trauma. No multi-web, no cross-map XP.
Requires Harmony. See README.md and DEVIATIONS.md.
